system.description:
AUDITORY GRIMWARD

You identify a behaviour, weakness or supernatural tell that your allies can exploit.
Action 1 AP
Requirements Your Judged Subject is within 60 feet, and you can perceive it.
Until the beginning of your next turn, allies within 30 feet who can hear and understand you gain a +1-circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects created by your Judged Subject.
At 12th level, they also gain a +1-circumstance bonus to the first attack roll they make against that Subject during the duration.

Prerequisites Level 6

Use (1 AP; target your Judged Subject): every targeted ally — target them too — gets +1 circumstance to saves from that creature until your next turn (and from 12th, +1 circumstance to their first attack against it).
